# Texas Crime and Justice Center

[The Texas Crime and Justice Center (TCJC) partners with agencies, policymakers, and communities to bring evidence to bear on crime and justice across Texas, the Southwest, and the nation.]{.lead}

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Stats strip: show only counts that are above zero, computed from data/*.yml
st <- list(c(s$fellows, "Research fellows"), c(s$projects, "Active projects"), c(s$grants_n, "Funded grants"))
st <- Filter(function(x) as.numeric(x[1]) > 0, st)
if (length(st) > 1) {
  cat('<div class="section-band column-screen"><div class="section"><span class="kicker">By the numbers</span><div class="stats">')
  for (x in st) cat(sprintf('<div class="stat"><span class="n">%s</span> <span class="l">%s</span></div>', x[1], x[2]))
  cat('</div></div></div>')
}
```
